title: Evaluation of propofol-induced effects on parameters of ventricular-arterial coupling by transthoracic echocardiography and cardial impedance measurement during anesthesia induction
summary:
Haemodynamic monitoring is part of diagnostic and therapeutic decisions in perioperative setting. Ultrasound-based assessment of cardial and vascular function by transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) is routinely used. Hereby parameters of coupling of the left heart and the arterial system (ventricular-arterial coupling, VAC) are examined. Furthermore, cardiac output is quantified by non-invasive impedance cardiography via EKG electrodes.
In this study, we will compare the alteration of noted parameters of VAC before and right after anesthesia induction. Parameters of cardiac output measured by TTE will be compared with measurements of impedance cardiography.

interventions.name: Patients with existing invasive blood pressure monitoring will be examined before und right after anesthesia induction via transthoracic echocardiography and impedance cardiography comparing parameters of ventricular-arterial coupling.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
monitoring with arterial catheter
Exclusion criteria:
pregnant patients
